# Installing the SDLC Marketplace on antigravity

<!-- Generated by `sdlc-lint emit`. Do not hand-edit — regenerate. -->

Built for `agy` 1.1.28, verified 2026-09-09.

## Install

There is no marketplace manifest on this host, so each plugin is installed by path.
Order does not matter; the core carries the pipeline and the rest add stack knowledge.

```bash
agy plugin install dist/antigravity/plugins/android-foundation
agy plugin install dist/antigravity/plugins/sdlc
```

## Reinstalling

`agy plugin install` **merges** into an existing install of the same name rather than replacing it.
A file that was renamed or removed upstream therefore survives as an orphan beside its
replacement. Uninstall first whenever file names may have changed:

```bash
agy plugin uninstall <plugin>
agy plugin install dist/antigravity/plugins/<plugin>
```

## Where it lands

Installs are **global**: measured on agy 1.1.28, `GEMINI_CONFIG_DIR`
is ignored by both install and list, and plugins always land under `$HOME/.gemini`.
A throwaway config directory cannot isolate an install on this host.

## Verify

```bash
agy plugin validate dist/antigravity/plugins/sdlc
agy plugin list
```

Then run `/sdlc-doctor` in a project to check stack detection and dependencies.
